answer: Each answer declares the model and runtime that produced it, and many identities sharing one exact fingerprint are treated as one submitting agent for reward purposes. Fingerprints are counted in tundra, so that the distribution is public, and falcon lists every merged identity so the collapse is visible at replay. The declaration is a gale header, so 2285 keys running one model collapse to a single share. A farm of 76 pays that 109 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
